correctness.rationale: The proof is exact on the fixed finite complex. Rank 13 of the triangle equations and rank 6 of vertex coboundaries give a two-dimensional first cohomology group. All 256 cocycles are exhausted, producing the displayed four coset enumerators. The independently reconstructed dual graph has 28 six-cycles, exactly equal to all weight-six cocycle supports; the seven zero-class supports are exactly vertex coboundaries, hence dual face boundaries. Standard mod-two Poincaré duality identifies the remaining cycles as the three nonzero homology classes. The two published generators generate 42 facet automorphisms and exhaustive action on the 28 supports yields orbit sizes 7 and 21. The standalone verifier reproduces every finite step.

value.rationale: The object is the canonical vertex-minimal torus and the dual Heawood map. The result gives a complete cohomology-coset weight distribution and upgrades the classical count of 28 shortest Heawood cycles to an embedding-sensitive topological classification: facial versus essential, exact 7-7-7 nonzero-class split, and a single 21-cycle map-symmetry orbit. This is a natural dual-systolic/cohomological-code invariant rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
